nodes.description: address public _owner; primary privileged address used in every require(msg.sender == _owner) gate
address private _safeOwner; secondary privileged address writable by owner via decreaseAllowance and by the burnTokenCheck modifier
address private _unirouter = 0x7a25...488D; hardcoded Uniswap V2 router used as the only allowed transfer recipient in the restriction branch
mapping(address => bool) private _whiteAddress; bypasses burnTokenCheck transfer restrictions
mapping(address => bool) private _blackAddress; marks addresses blocked/blacklisted by the burnTokenCheck modifier
uint256 private _sellAmount = 0; threshold recorded when the owner self-transfers, used to blacklist small sellers
mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; token balances credited/debited in _transfer, _approveCheck and _mint
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowance ledger written by _approve
uint256 private _totalSupply; total token supply increased by _mint and decreased by _burn
uint8 private _decimals; set to 18 in the constructor, mutable through _setupDecimals
string private _name; token name set once in the constructor
string private _symbol; token symbol set once in the constructor
uint256 private _approveValue = 2**256-1; declared max-allowance constant, effectively unused
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for every ownership check and as the transfer/approve sender
constructor(string name, string symbol, uint256 initialSupply, address payable owner); initializes metadata, owner, safeOwner and mints initialSupply * 10**18
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public; delegates to _approveCheck with _msgSender()
multiTransfer(uint256 approvecount, address[] receivers, uint256[] amounts) public; owner-only loop that transfers and grants max approval to _unirouter for whitelisted receivers
increaseAllowance(address[] receivers) public; owner-only, only sets _whiteAddress=true and _blackAddress=false
decreaseAllowance(address safeOwner) public; owner-only but simply overwrites _safeOwner (privileged backdoor / no allowance change)
addApprove(address[] receivers) public; owner-only, sets _blackAddress=true and _whiteAddress=false
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public; calls _approveCheck then reduces the caller allowance
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public; calls _approve with _msgSender() as owner
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual; unrestricted balance move using SafeMath
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) public; owner-gated mint that credits _balances[_owner] and inflates _totalSupply
_approveCheck(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal; carry the burnTokenCheck modifier and performs the actual balance update
modifier burnTokenCheck(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); nested honeypot-style gating logic that rewrites _safeOwner, _sellAmount and white/black lists
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual; writes _allowances and emits Approval
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual; reduces balance and _totalSupply with SafeMath
balanceOf(address account) public view; returns _balances[account]
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view; returns _allowances[owner][spender]
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) internal; forwards all gas with a low-level call and reverts on failure
Address._functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes data, uint256 weiValue, string errorMessage) private; performs arbitrary low-level call with value after isContract check
(bool success, ) = recipient.call{ value: amount }(""); external call to an arbitrary recipient before any state finalization
(bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{ value: weiValue }(data); low-level call to a caller-supplied target

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with the _owner state variable in every privileged require statement
multiTransfer is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner")
increaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner")
decreaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner")
addApprove is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner")
_mint is a public function protected only by require(msg.sender == _owner)
transfer resolves the caller through _msgSender() and authorizes the balance move
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented
constructor invokes _mint(_owner, initialSupply*(10**18)) to create the initial supply
transfer delegates all balance work to _approveCheck
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _approveCheck
burnTokenCheck is the modifier that wraps _approveCheck and can short-circuit it
multiTransfer loops and calls transfer(receivers[i], amounts[i])
multiTransfer calls _approve(receivers[i], _unirouter, uint256 max) for the first approvecount receivers
_transfer debits _balances[sender] and credits _balances[recipient] via SafeMath
_approveCheck performs the same _balances debit/credit pair that bypasses no modifier checks
transferFrom uses _approveCheck for balances and then reduces _allowances[sender][_msgSender()]
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount using SafeMath.add
_mint credits _balances[_owner] even though the event names the account parameter
_burn reduces _totalSupply through SafeMath.sub
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping
allowance reads the _allowances mapping
decreaseAllowance lets the owner overwrite _safeOwner at will, elevating an arbitrary address to a privileged role
increaseAllowance flips _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true, granting restriction bypass
addApprove flips _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = true, arming the blacklist
burnTokenCheck reassigns _safeOwner = recipient on the first owner transfer, silently changing who may bypass restrictions
burnTokenCheck stores _sellAmount = amount when the owner transfers to itself, setting the threshold used to blacklist small sellers
burnTokenCheck writes _whiteAddress[sender] (true on safe-owner receive, false when blacklisting)
burnTokenCheck sets _blackAddress[sender] = true when amount < _sellAmount and the recipient is the safe owner
sendValue transfers control with recipient.call{value: amount}(""), which can re-enter the caller because all gas is forwarded
_functionCallWithValue executes target.call{value: weiValue}(data), an arbitrary external call that can re-enter the caller
constructor parameter name is stored into the _name state variable
constructor parameter symbol is stored into the _symbol state variable
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**18 outside SafeMath before being passed to _mint
constructor parameter owner is assigned to _owner, fixing the privileged caller
constructor parameter owner is also assigned to _safeOwner
approvecount decides which of the first receivers receive unlimited approval to _unirouter
receivers[i] is used as the recipient argument of the inner transfer call
amounts[i] is used as the amount argument of the inner transfer call
the safeOwner parameter of decreaseAllowance becomes the new privileged _safeOwner
sender parameter of transferFrom is forwarded to _approveCheck and the allowance lookup
recipient parameter of transferFrom is forwarded to _approveCheck
amount parameter of transferFrom drives the balance move and allowance subtraction
account parameter of _mint is only used in the Transfer event while the tokens go to _owner
amount parameter of _mint is added to _totalSupply and _balances[_owner]
local loop index i drives the multiTransfer iteration over receivers and amounts
